description: Land Title Settlement Department - Magammana, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520003
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property details. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
